```{r setup, include=FALSE}
outliers <- function(x) {
  (abs(x - mean(x, na.rm= T)) > (sd(x, na.rm= T) * 2))
}
naoutlier <- function(x) ifelse(outliers(x), NA, x)


growthrate <- function(df, varInterest, smooth_var){
  
  modelformula <- as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ s(age, k = 3, fx = T) + s(Subject, bs = 're')", varInterest))
  gam.model <-  gam(modelformula, method = "REML", family = gaussian(link = "identity"), data = df)
  gam.results <- summary(gam.model)
  
  derv <- derivatives(gam.model, term = 'age', interval = "simultaneous", unconditional = F, partial_match = T) #derivative at 200 indices of smooth_var with a simultaneous CI
  
  
  #GAM derivatives
  #Get derivatives of the smooth function using finite differences
  #derv <- derivatives(gam.model, term = 'age', data = pred, interval = "simultaneous", unconditional = F, partial_match = T) #derivative at 200 indices of smooth_var with a simultaneous CI
  #Identify derivative significance window(s)
  derv <- derv %>% #add "sig" column (TRUE/FALSE) to derv
    mutate(sig = !(0 > .lower_ci & 0 < .upper_ci)) #derivative is sig if the lower CI is not < 0 while the upper CI is > 0 (i.e., when the CI does not include 0)
  derv$sig_deriv = derv$.derivative*derv$sig #add "sig_deriv derivatives column where non-significant derivatives are set to 0
  mean.derivative <- mean(derv$.derivative)
  
  #Model summary outputs
  #Signed F value for the smooth term and GAM-based significance of the smooth term
  gam.smooth.F <- gam.results$s.table[1,3] #first row is s(smooth_var), third entry is F
  if(mean.derivative < 0){ #if the average derivative is less than 0, make the effect size estimate negative
    gam.smooth.F <- gam.smooth.F*-1}
  
  gam.smooth.pvalue <- gam.results$s.table[1,4] #first row is s(smooth_var), fourth entry is p-value
  
  
  #Age of developmental change onset
  if(sum(derv$sig) > 0){ #if derivative is significant at at least 1 age
    change.onset <- min(derv$age[derv$sig==T])} #find first age in the smooth where derivative is significant
  if(sum(derv$sig) == 0){ #if gam derivative is never significant
    change.onset <- NA} #assign NA
  
  #Age of maximal developmental change
  if(sum(derv$sig) > 0){ 
    derv$abs_sig_deriv = round(abs(derv$sig_deriv),5) #absolute value significant derivatives
    maxval <- max(derv$abs_sig_deriv) #find the largest derivative
    window.peak.change <- derv$age[derv$abs_sig_deriv == maxval] #identify the age(s) at which the derivative is greatest in absolute magnitude
    peak.change <- mean(window.peak.change)} #identify the age of peak developmental change
  if(sum(derv$sig) == 0){ 
    peak.change <- NA}  
  
  #Age of decrease onset
  if(sum(derv$sig) > 0){ 
    decreasing.range <- derv$age[derv$sig_deriv < 0] #identify all ages with a significant negative derivative (i.e., smooth_var indices where y is decreasing)
    if(length(decreasing.range) > 0)
      decrease.onset <- min(decreasing.range) #find youngest age with a significant negative derivative
    if(length(decreasing.range) == 0)
      decrease.onset <- NA}
  if(sum(derv$sig) == 0){
    decrease.onset <- NA}  
  
  #Age of decrease offset
  if(sum(derv$sig) > 0){ 
    decreasing.range <- derv$age[derv$sig_deriv < 0] #identify all ages with a significant negative derivative (i.e., smooth_var indices where y is decreasing)
    if(length(decreasing.range) > 0){
      last.decrease <- max(decreasing.range) #find oldest age with a significant negative derivative
      if(last.decrease == derv$age[length(derv$age)]) #if the last age of significant decrease is the oldest in the dataset
        decrease.offset <- last.decrease
      if(last.decrease != derv$age[length(derv$age)]){ 
        decrease.offset.row <- which(derv$age == last.decrease) + 1 #use above to find the first age when the derivative is not significant
        decrease.offset <- derv$age[decrease.offset.row]}
    }
    if(length(decreasing.range) == 0)
      decrease.offset <- NA}
  if(sum(derv$sig) == 0){ 
    decrease.offset <- NA}  
  
  #Age of increase onset
  if(sum(derv$sig) > 0){ 
    increasing.range <- derv$age[derv$sig_deriv > 0] #identify all ages with a significant positive derivative (i.e., smooth_var indices where y is increasing)
    if(length(increasing.range) > 0)
      increase.onset <- min(increasing.range) #find oldest age with a significant positive derivative
    if(length(increasing.range) == 0)
      increase.onset <- NA}
  if(sum(derv$sig) == 0){ 
    increase.onset <- NA}  
  
  #Age of increase offset
  if(sum(derv$sig) > 0){ 
    increasing.range <- derv$age[derv$sig_deriv > 0] #identify all ages with a significant positive derivative (i.e., smooth_var indices where y is increasing)
    if(length(increasing.range) > 0){
      last.increase <- max(increasing.range) #find oldest age with a significant positive derivative
      if(last.increase == derv$age[length(derv$age)]) #if the last age of significant increase is the oldest in the dataset
        increase.offset <- last.increase
      if(last.increase != derv$age[length(derv$age)]){ 
        increase.offset.row <- which(derv$age == last.increase) + 1 #use above to find the first age when the derivative is not significant
        increase.offset <- derv$age[increase.offset.row]}
    }
    if(length(increasing.range) == 0)
      increase.offset <- NA}
  if(sum(derv$sig) == 0){ 
    increase.offset <- NA}  
  
  #Age of last change
  if(sum(derv$sig) > 0){ 
    change.offset <- max(derv$age[derv$sig==T])} #find last age in the smooth where derivative is significant
  if(sum(derv$sig) == 0){ 
    change.offset <- NA}  
  
  gam.statistics <- data.frame(GAM.smooth.Fvalue = as.numeric(gam.smooth.F), GAM.smooth.pvalue = as.numeric(gam.smooth.pvalue), 
                               smooth.change.onset = as.numeric(change.onset), smooth.peak.change = as.numeric(peak.change), smooth.decrease.onset = as.numeric(decrease.onset), 
                               smooth.decrease.offset = as.numeric(decrease.offset), smooth.increase.onset = as.numeric(increase.onset), 
                               smooth.increase.offset = as.numeric(increase.offset), smooth.last.change = as.numeric(change.offset))
  
  
  gam.derivatives <- derv %>% select(age, .derivative, .lower_ci, .upper_ci, sig, sig_deriv)
  names(gam.derivatives) <- c("age", "derivative", "lower", "upper", "significant", "significant.derivative")
  
  gam.results <- list(gam.statistics, gam.derivatives, gam.model)
  names(gam.results) <- list("gam.statistics", "gam.derivatives", "model")
  return(gam.results)
}
```

# Assign channels to a region

```{r}
patient_channel <- read.csv('/Users/shanemckeon/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofPittsburgh/PBE_Lab/acw_project/acw/patient_channels.csv')
ACW_channelLabels <- merge(seegACW_avgSecEpochs, patient_channel, by=c('Subject', 'channel'))

channelROIs <- read.csv('/Users/shanemckeon/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofPittsburgh/PBE_Lab/acw_project/allSubjectsROIs.csv')
colnames(channelROIs)[colnames(channelROIs) == "channel"] <- "Channel_Label"

ACW_channelLabels_ROI <- merge(ACW_channelLabels, channelROIs, by=c('Subject', 'Channel_Label'))


assign_lobe <- function(df) {
  df$Lobe <- NA  # Initialize column
  
  # Frontal Lobe
  df$Lobe[grepl("\\bPreCG\\b|\\bIFG\\b|\\bMFG\\b|\\bSFG\\b|\\bOFC\\b|Frontal|Operculum|\\bSMA\\b|\\bACC\\b|\\bpACC\\b|\\bsACC\\b|\\bIFS\\b|\\bSFS\\b", df$ROI, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Frontal"
  
  # Temporal Lobe
  df$Lobe[grepl("\\bSTG\\b|\\bMTG\\b|\\bITG\\b|Hippocampus|Amygdala|\\bFusG\\b|Entorhinal|\\bPhG\\b|HESCHL|\\bSTS\\b|Temporal|\\bCoS\\b", df$ROI, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Temporal"
  
  # Parietal Lobe
  df$Lobe[grepl("\\bPostCG\\b|\\bIPL\\b|\\bSPL\\b|Precuneus|\\bIPS\\b|\\bPOperc\\b", df$ROI, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Parietal"
  
  # Occipital Lobe — make sure V1 and V2 are matched safely
  df$Lobe[grepl("\\bV1\\b|\\bV2\\b|\\bLOC\\b|Cuneus|\\bLingG\\b|\\bPOS\\b|\\bhOc\\b", df$ROI, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Occipital"
  
  return(df)
}& Lobe != 'Temporal'

ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes <- assign_lobe(ACW_channelLabels_ROI) %>% filter(!is.na(Lobe) )

write.csv(ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes, '/Users/shanemckeon/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofPittsburgh/PBE_Lab/acw_project/allSubChannelsAssignedToLobe.csv')


ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes_outlier <- ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes %>% group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(across(c("ACW_50"), naoutlier)) %>% ungroup()
```

# Non seizure electrodes 
```{r}
library(readxl)
nonEpContacts <- read_excel('/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/sEEG/nonEPcontacts.xlsx')

ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes_outlier <- separate(ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes_outlier, Channel_Label, into = c("Letter", "Number"), sep = "_", convert = TRUE) 

# List of subjects
subjects <-intersect(unique(nonEpContacts$Subject), unique(ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes_outlier$Subject))

result <- data.frame()

# Loop through subjects
for (subject in subjects) {
  
  # Initialize lists to store letters and numbers
  letters_list <- c()
  numbers_list <- c()
  
  # Select contacts for the current subject
  selectContacts <- nonEpContacts %>%
    filter(Subject == subject)
  
  # Process each contact segment
  for (segment in selectContacts$nonEpContacts) {
    # Split each segment into letter and numbers part
    parts <- strsplit(segment, " ")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) > 1) {
      letter <- parts[1]
      ranges_string <- paste(parts[-1], collapse = " ")  # Join remaining parts
      
      # Split ranges by comma to handle multiple ranges
      ranges <- strsplit(ranges_string, ", ")[[1]]
      
      # Function to expand ranges like "1-5" to individual numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
      expand_range <- function(range) {
        range_parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(range, "-")[[1]])
        if (length(range_parts) == 2 && all(!is.na(range_parts))) {
          return(range_parts[1]:range_parts[2])
        } else {
          warning("Invalid range:", range)
          return(NULL)
        }
      }
      
      # Process each range in the segment
      for (range in ranges) {
        # Expand range into individual numbers
        expanded_numbers <- expand_range(range)
        if (!is.null(expanded_numbers)) {
          # Append letter and expanded numbers to lists
          letters_list <- c(letters_list, rep(letter, length(expanded_numbers)))
          numbers_list <- c(numbers_list, expanded_numbers)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Create a data frame with letters and numbers
  letterNumberList <- data.frame(
    Letter = letters_list,
    Number = numbers_list
  )
  
  filteredData <- merge(ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes_outlier, letterNumberList, by = c("Letter", "Number")) %>%
    subset(., !grepl('EEG', Letter)) %>%
    filter(Subject == subject)
  
  # Bind filtered data to result
  result <- rbind(result, filteredData)
}
```

# Seizure electrodes 
```{r}
nonEpContacts <- read_excel('/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/sEEG/nonEPcontacts.xlsx')

# List of subjects
subjects <-intersect(unique(nonEpContacts$Subject), unique(ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes_outlier$Subject))

result_seizureElectrodes <- data.frame()

# Loop through subjects
for (subject in subjects) {
  
  # Initialize lists to store letters and numbers
  letters_list <- c()
  numbers_list <- c()
  
  # Select contacts for the current subject
  selectContacts <- nonEpContacts %>%
    filter(Subject == subject)
  
  # Process each contact segment
  for (segment in selectContacts$nonEpContacts) {
    # Split each segment into letter and numbers part
    parts <- strsplit(segment, " ")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) > 1) {
      letter <- parts[1]
      ranges_string <- paste(parts[-1], collapse = " ")  # Join remaining parts
      
      # Split ranges by comma to handle multiple ranges
      ranges <- strsplit(ranges_string, ", ")[[1]]
      
      # Function to expand ranges like "1-5" to individual numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
      expand_range <- function(range) {
        range_parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(range, "-")[[1]])
        if (length(range_parts) == 2 && all(!is.na(range_parts))) {
          return(range_parts[1]:range_parts[2])
        } else {
          warning("Invalid range:", range)
          return(NULL)
        }
      }
      
      # Process each range in the segment
      for (range in ranges) {
        # Expand range into individual numbers
        expanded_numbers <- expand_range(range)
        if (!is.null(expanded_numbers)) {
          # Append letter and expanded numbers to lists
          letters_list <- c(letters_list, rep(letter, length(expanded_numbers)))
          numbers_list <- c(numbers_list, expanded_numbers)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Create a data frame with letters and numbers
  letterNumberList <- data.frame(
    Letter = letters_list,
    Number = numbers_list
  )
  
  filteredData_seizureElectrodes <- anti_join(ACW_channelLabels_ROI_lobes_outlier, letterNumberList, by = c("Letter", "Number")) %>%
    subset(., !grepl('EEG', Letter)) %>%
    filter(Subject == subject)
  
  # Bind filtered data to result
  result_seizureElectrodes <- rbind(result_seizureElectrodes, filteredData_seizureElectrodes)
}


lunaize(ggplot(data = result_seizureElectrodes, aes(x = age, y = ACW_50))) + geom_point(aes(color=Lobe), alpha =0.3) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group=1, color = Lobe), method=mgcv::"gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 3, fx = T), alpha=0.3, linewidth = 1.5) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#012b0d", "#90b8a6", "#27763d")) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .2), 
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .2),
    strip.background = element_rect('white')) + facet_wrap(~Lobe)

ggsave(filename = "/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/sEEG/acw/Figures/lobesEPelectrodes_ACW_acrossAge.pdf", device = "pdf", dpi = 500, width = 15, height = 6)
```
